title: [Editor][3D] Viewport navigation is flawed and imprecise
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 3.6.stable, 4.8.dev3, master [20a52a8]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (ea28334bc) - macOS Unknown (27.0.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (4112x2658 @ 120.00 Hz) - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads) - 48.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The [editor code that handles the 3D pan](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/20a52a8988b1170a53e0e04a7d71a0cb26f71656/scene/debugger/view_3d_controller.cpp#L328-L350) and [the one that handles the 3D orbit](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/20a52a8988b1170a53e0e04a7d71a0cb26f71656/scene/debugger/view_3d_controller.cpp#L352-L410) are flawed in their calculation of translation and rotation.

They base the rate of panning and orbiting based on arbitrary values and the number of pixels travelled. It computes the panning based on a magic value applied to each pixel moved for the pan, and the same thing happens (but for the rate of rotation) for the orbit.

The arbitrary values are set as degrees of rotation per pixel set as these editor settings:
- `editors/3d/navigation_feel/translation_sensitivity`
- `editors/3d/navigation_feel/orbit_sensitivity`
- `editors/3d/navigation_feel/freelook_sensitivity`

This has for consequence of making the navigating the viewport less intuitive. The same relative motion doesn't get the same viewport result.

### Steps to reproduce

You just have to use the navigation features in a 3D scene.
